_about: Ground-truth visual-defect labels for the Aesthetic Director. Each scene = 5 keyframes under frames/<scene>/. Labels assigned by a human-equivalent reviewer (Claude Opus 4.8) who OPENED every settled frame — never a model score. 'defect' scenes are the recall floor: the judge must NEVER miss these. 'clean' scenes are where the OLD critic produced false alarms (normal full-frame curves, traced dots, translucent fills, colored arrows, sheared grids).
